subtitle.en: A faster path from a quota glance to the full story
subtitle.zh-Hans: 从额度速览，更快进入完整用量视图

body.en: Keep Codex and Claude limits, reset times, tokens, and API-equivalent usage within one click of the menu bar.
body.zh-Hans: 从菜单栏点一下，即可查看 Codex 与 Claude 的额度、重置时间、Token 和 API 等价用量。

accessibilityLabel.en: Quota Monitor menu popover showing synthetic Codex and Claude quotas.
accessibilityLabel.zh-Hans: Quota Monitor 菜单弹窗，展示合成的 Codex 与 Claude 额度数据。

title.en: From the menu bar to the full picture
title.zh-Hans: 从菜单栏，进入完整视图

body.en: A short, silent walkthrough connects the compact readout with Dashboard Forecast and Trends. Playback pauses whenever the page or window goes away.
body.zh-Hans: 这段简短的静音演示会把紧凑读数与 Dashboard 的 Forecast 和 Trends 串起来；切换页面或关闭窗口后会立即暂停。

accessibilityLabel.en: Silent transition from the synthetic menu-bar quota popover to the Dashboard overview.
accessibilityLabel.zh-Hans: 从合成的菜单栏额度弹窗过渡到 Dashboard 总览的静音演示。

title.zh-Hans: 操作更流畅，后台更轻量

body.en: Search waits for a pause in typing, incremental imports focus on new data, and unchanged refreshes avoid rebuilding the same summaries.
body.zh-Hans: 搜索会等输入停顿后再刷新，增量导入只关注新数据，无变化的后台刷新也不再重复计算相同摘要。

accessibilityLabel.en: Quota Monitor Dashboard with synthetic Forecast and Trends data.
accessibilityLabel.zh-Hans: Quota Monitor Dashboard，展示合成的 Forecast 与 Trends 数据。

subtitle.en: Live quotas, faster insights, and costs that stay accurate
subtitle.zh-Hans: 实时额度、更快洞察，以及始终准确的费用

title.en: Codex quotas, right where you work
title.zh-Hans: Codex 额度，就在当前窗口

body.en: See 5-hour and 7-day usage beside the active Codex window. Hover or click for reset times and reset credits; the compact detail card closes naturally when you move on.
body.zh-Hans: 在当前 Codex 窗口旁直接查看 5 小时与 7 天额度；悬停或点击即可展开重置时间与主动重置卡，移开后详情会自然收起。

accessibilityLabel.en: Compact 5-hour and 7-day Codex quota widget with its branded detail card and synthetic reset data.
accessibilityLabel.zh-Hans: 紧凑的 Codex 5 小时与 7 天额度挂件，以及使用合成重置数据的品牌详情卡。

title.en: A large history still feels light
title.zh-Hans: 历史再多，操作依然轻快

body.en: Sessions, search, Dashboard charts, and the year heatmap now reuse work and load progressively, while routine refreshes stay quiet in the background.
body.zh-Hans: 会话、搜索、Dashboard 图表与全年热图现在会复用结果并渐进加载，日常刷新也会在后台安静完成。

accessibilityLabel.en: Silent walkthrough from the synthetic menu-bar quota view to Dashboard charts.
accessibilityLabel.zh-Hans: 从合成菜单栏额度视图进入 Dashboard 图表的静音演示。

title.zh-Hans: 历史与现在，费用都准确

body.en: Bundled pricing now covers GPT-5.6 and Claude Opus 5, and historical usage keeps the rate that applied on the day it happened.
body.zh-Hans: 随包价格现在覆盖 GPT-5.6 与 Claude Opus 5，历史用量仍会保留发生当天真正适用的费率。

accessibilityLabel.en: Synthetic History view showing token-weighted cache rate, models, sessions, and calculated costs.
accessibilityLabel.zh-Hans: 使用合成数据展示 Token 加权缓存命中率、模型、会话与计算费用的历史页面。

title.zh-Hans: 更新更安静，重点不错过

body.en: Background checks stay quiet; one click downloads and prepares the update, and this visual guide remains available whenever you want to revisit the highlights.
body.zh-Hans: 后台检查保持安静，一次点击即可下载并准备更新；这份图文导览也会一直保留，方便随时重看重点。

accessibilityLabel.en: Quota Monitor 1.0 update window with four English release-highlight cards.
accessibilityLabel.zh-Hans: 带有四张中文更新亮点卡片的 Quota Monitor 1.0 更新窗口。
